notes:
NuVo tuner: the apps can now browse the tuner's own presets, folders and modes and select them directly.
NuVo control pad menus: the menu designer gains options per item (highlight, checkmark, greyed, ask before running, where to go afterwards), names filled in from the room and source, a Rooms list to group rooms on a source, ready-made sleep timer, wake-up and daily all-off folders, and items whose caption shows live information. Setup installs an example with a Weather item. The designer page is also easier to read. In this release the menus are saved only; the control pads keep their current menus.
